display_name: Spawn MCP bridge subprocess (macOS coding-agent session plugin)
description: macOS implementation of spawn_bridge: starts `python -m agent_messaging_plugin.mcp_bridge` as a child of the solet process and tracks it under the supplied agent_instance_id. See service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::spawn_bridge for the canonical contract; this plugin-side process key is the bound provider's surface and resolves to the same verb. Bound-provider skip semantics (per `0e72ac15`) mean callers route through the service_interface::* key, not this plugin::* key.
embedding_description: macOS-scope implementation of spawn_bridge — starts an MCP bridge subprocess as a child of the solet process (not iTerm2) and records its pid keyed by agent_instance_id. Mirrors the canonical service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::spawn_bridge contract. Returns BridgeSpawnResult.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeSpawnResult frozen dataclass mirroring the canonical service interface return.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: See the canonical service_interface entry; the plugin-side surface mirrors it.
